directions.name: Nočno vzhajanje
directions.idea: The bread is made at night, so the site is the bakery's night: a deep night-blue page lit by warm loaves and cut through by the baker's scoring strokes taken from the logo.
directions.type: Display: DM Serif Display, a high-contrast, sturdy serif, set very large in upright roman only and never italic, in off-white #F1ECE2. Body and navigation: Instrument Sans, regular and medium, sentence case. The hours table uses Instrument Sans with tabular figures. The phone number is set in DM Serif Display at around 9vw.
directions.composition: First screen: a thin top bar with the logo on the left and the four navigation words on the right in Instrument Sans, with a hairline rule below. The hero is asymmetric. Columns 1–7 hold the headline over three lines at about 7vw, left-aligned, then the intro in two lines of 20px text, then one rectangular crust-brown button 'Pokličite' with square corners. Columns 8–12 hold the loaves-on-shelf photo, bled to the top and right edges and cropped tall. Three long parallel diagonal wheat strokes, like the scores on a loaf, run from the photo across behind the headline. Section 2, 'Vsak dan': the hands-shaping-dough photo bleeds off the left edge across columns 1–5. Columns 7–12 hold the heading 'Vsak dan' and a five-line list in 32px serif, each line with a small wheat diagonal score mark before it. Below the list, a full-width wheat #EBC98A band carries the Friday–Saturday note in dark night text. Section 3: a deeper #0E1222 field. Columns 1–5 hold the hours table with hairline rows and the address. Columns 6–12 hold the phone '041 555 906' as a huge serif numeral with a simple line-drawn schematic map of Šutna below it, marked by a single wheat score mark. The croissant photo sits as a narrow, bled strip at the bottom right.
directions.imagery: The client's own three photographs only, bled to the edges, with warm natural colour kept against the dark ground. Simple wheat-coloured line strokes (the three logo scores) serve as the only drawn ornament. A schematic line map is drawn in hairlines.
directions.signature: The three scoring slashes from the logo are enlarged into long diagonal wheat-coloured cuts that slice across the night-blue hero and reappear as list markers and as the map pin, as if the baker's blade had scored the page itself.
directions.imagePrompt: One flat full-page website screenshot, 1536×1024, desktop homepage, no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective. Page ground deep night blue #141A2E. Text off-white #F1ECE2, accent crust brown #C8742F, wheat #EBC98A, hairline rules #2E3754. Top bar: the attached Pekarna Kvas logo (brown oval loaf with three light diagonal scores, 'Kvas' wordmark, 'PEKARNA · KAMNIK') at left, recoloured so it reads on dark, and at right the navigation 'Domov', 'Kruh in pecivo', 'Naročila', 'Kontakt' in a clean sans-serif, sentence case, with a thin hairline below. Hero, asymmetric on a 12-column grid. Left columns 1–7: the huge headline 'Kruh z drožmi, ki vzhaja čez noč' in a high-contrast upright serif like DM Serif Display (no italics), off-white, left-aligned over three lines. Below it the intro in a clean sans-serif: 'Družinska pekarna na začetku stare ulice v Kamniku. Vse je ročno delo, brez aditivov in brez zamrznjenega testa.' Below that, one single rectangular square-cornered button in #C8742F with off-white text 'Pokličite'. Right columns 8–12: the attached photo of round sourdough loaves on wooden shelves, cropped tall and bled to the top and right edges. Three long parallel diagonal strokes in wheat #EBC98A, like bread scoring marks, sweep from the photo across the dark ground behind the headline. Next section, partially visible below: the attached photo of floured hands shaping dough, bled off the left edge, without showing any face. On the right, the heading 'Vsak dan' in large serif and a list, each line preceded by a small wheat diagonal mark: 'Pirin kruh z drožmi', 'Rženi kruh', 'Polnozrnate žemlje', 'Rogljički z maslom', 'Cimetovi polži'. Under it, a full-width wheat #EBC98A band with dark text: 'Ob petkih in sobotah še orehova potica in kvašeni krofi'. Lower section on a deeper #0E1222 field. Left: an hours table with thin rules showing 'Pon–pet 6.30–18.00', 'Sob 6.30–12.00', 'Ned 7.00–10.00', and the address 'Šutna 30, 1241 Kamnik'. Right: the phone '041 555 906' as a very large serif numeral, with a simple hairline schematic street map below it. A narrow strip of the attached croissants and cinnamon rolls photo is bled at the bottom right edge. Flat design: no gradients, no shadows, no glass effects, no pill buttons, no icons, no emoji, no prices, no stars or reviews, no extra text beyond what is quoted, no people's faces, nothing centred.

directions.name: Polica
directions.idea: The whole page is built like Jure's wooden bread shelf: on a pure white, flour-clean ground, every section rests on a thick plank of oak colour, and the daily breads are stacked on it as giant words.

palette.role: button and single hot accent, oven red

directions.type: Display: Anton, a tall, condensed, heavy grotesque, set huge (up to 11vw) in dark rye, in sentence case as written. Body and navigation: Work Sans, regular and semibold. The list of breads is set in Anton at around 6vw, one item per line. The phone numeral is in Anton.
directions.composition: First screen: the logo at the left and the navigation at the right on white, with a thick oak plank rule (about 14px) running full width beneath like a shelf board. The headline fills columns 1–9, stacked in four condensed lines at about 10vw, flush left, sitting directly on a second oak plank. The croissants photo occupies columns 8–12, bled to the right edge and overlapping the last headline line from behind. The intro sits in columns 1–5 under the plank, next to one rectangular oven-red button 'Pokličite' with square corners. Section 2, 'Vsak dan': a small heading, then the five breads stacked as giant condensed lines in columns 1–8, each line resting on its own thin oak plank rule, like loaves on a shelf. The loaves photo is bled off the right edge across columns 9–12 at full section height. Below it, a ribbon strip in crust #9B5A1E runs edge to edge with the Friday–Saturday note in white-ish text. Section 3 is a split colour field: columns 1–6 are deep rye #3B2414 with the phone as a huge numeral and the address; columns 7–12 are white with the hours table on oak rules, the hands photo cropped square beneath, and a schematic map line drawing.
directions.imagery: The client's three photographs, cropped hard and bled to the page edges, high-contrast against white. The oak plank rules are the ornament. A thin-line schematic map is drawn in dark rye.
directions.signature: The 'Vsak dan' list is set in enormous condensed type, each bread name resting on its own thick oak-coloured plank, so the visitor literally reads the bakery shelf.
